provider: Built-in image generation and deterministic SVG diagrams
style: Layered cut-paper collage with simple paper-color science diagrams
lessonTitles: The lit half and the dark half
The Moon in a blue sky
note: Paper collage pictures are illustrative, not scale drawings or exact maps. Diagram arrows show light paths or turning; they are not solid beams or orbital paths. The Sun stays fixed only in this simplified daily-rotation model, not absolutely still in space. Left-to-right horizon panels represent apparent sky motion as Earth turns. Stars remain in space during daytime; they are usually hidden by bright sky. A Moon picture does not imply it is visible every night. Shadow panels show possible changes, not a guaranteed direction or length. Never look directly at the Sun.

sources.prompt: Use case: scientific-educational. Square Grade 1 educational CUT-PAPER COLLAGE. Hand-cut colored paper shapes, visible fine paper fibers, gently irregular cut edges, shallow layered paper shadows, restrained composition. Not a cartoon drawing, not photorealistic, not a 3D render. No outlines, no faces, no people, no text, letters, numerals, logos, watermark or labels. Astronomical objects are round, never five-point shapes. A single round golden-yellow Sun disk made of layered yellow and amber paper on deep indigo paper background. A few short paper ray strips may suggest light, not solid spikes. No planets or flames.
sources.alt: Layered golden paper circles and short ray strips form a bright disk against dark blue paper.
